source.check: Contests from the Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 8, checked against the News-Letter and Irish News; unopposed returns from the Ulster Herald, 20 May 1967, p. 14.

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. Three divisions were contested; the Dooratt result was not printed in the reports used here and is not recorded. The other 25 seats were filled unopposed. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
